question: What comprehensive powers, accomplishments, and temporal benefits are bestowed by the subject?
premises: The subject grants all sovereignty and all accomplishments.
The subject gives benefits at all times.
inference: The subject bestows complete power, success, and enduring benefits.
uncertainties: sarvakāladam may mean granting all time or effective at all times
plain_english: It grants all sovereignty, all accomplishments, and benefits at all times.
